mapper.select: select page_id, image_name, prev_name, next_name, has_prev, has_next, local_file, file_size, create_time from tj_guben_page where image_name = #{imageName}
mapper.insert: insert into tj_guben_page (image_name, prev_name, next_name, has_prev, has_next, local_file, file_size, create_time) values (#{imageName}, #{prevName}, #{nextName}, #{hasPrev}, #{hasNext}, #{localFile}, #{fileSize}, now())
mapper.select: select anchor_id, tongjian_id, start_index, image_name, box_top, box_left, box_width, box_height, create_time from tj_guben_anchor where tongjian_id = #{tongjianId} and start_index = #{startIndex}
mapper.insert: insert into tj_guben_anchor (tongjian_id, start_index, image_name, box_top, box_left, box_width, box_height, create_time) values (#{tongjianId}, #{startIndex}, #{imageName}, #{boxTop}, #{boxLeft}, #{boxWidth}, #{boxHeight}, now())
mapper.select: select c.content_id, c.tongjian_id, c.number, c.original, c.simplified from tj_content c where c.tongjian_id is not null and not exists ( select 1 from tj_guben_anchor a where a.tongjian_id = c.tongjian_id and a.start_index = coalesce(c.number, 1) - 1 ) order by c.content_id
select count(1) from tj_guben_page where local_file is not null
select coalesce(sum(file_size), 0) from tj_guben_page where local_file is not null
